title: Sensual Artistry
description:
Welcome, Sweeteas!
Here, I take down into trance with a relatively short Elman/staircase induction and invite you into my bedroom, where we collide with a brightly-lit passion of two starved lovers. We kiss, we touch, and we appreciate each other in a slow, sensual way. Our pleasures are shared, so what you feel, I feel…and what I feel, you do. It’s mind-blowing.
This is a very visual and tactile experience, immersive in a way that reaches so deeply into your mind and makes you tingle in all the right places.
Nothing “out there” happens here. It’s just a really nice, intimate meeting between two souls who are drawn to one another.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
There are 4 versions of this file:
Full SFX with wakener: Voice effects (panning, echoes, ASMR, 3D, etc.) and external environmental sound effects and music. This comes with a short countup at the very end to take you gently out of trance.
Full SFX without wakener: Just like the above, but you drift off into sleep instead.
RAW+moans with wakener: This is the raw voice file, with moans added in the right places for the full experience. No voice or other sound effects. Wakes you up at the end.
RAW+moans without wakener: Same as above, but lets you drift off into sleep afterwards.
author: Miss Lilith
